Manx: President: REV. CANON SAVAGE, M.A., F.S.A., Douglas.
Hon. Secretary: Miss S. Morrison, Peel.
Gur eh mie mooar diu, son cur nyn ennym stiagh myr oltey jeh’n Cheshaght Gailckagh, myrgeddin son yn argid.
English: Thank you very much, for submitting your name as a member of the Manx Society, as well as the money.

Manx: Ta dy chooilley ennym cooney lhien dy chummal seose, as cur er ash chengey ny mayrey Ellan Vannin.
English: Each and every name helps us to support, and restore the mother-tongue of the Isle of Man.

Manx: Ta shin nish strieu dy gheddyn Gailck ynsit ayns ny schoillyn, as ta shin jerkal dy vow mayd speedeil mie.
English: We are now striving to get Manx taught in the schools, and we expect that we will get good prosper [sic].
